responses.text:
Added 0.2 mm clearance to the Housing group, per side, where the Pin sits in the Base.

- The Pin is a 10 × 10 × 20 mm box, z 10–30. The Base is 40 × 40 × 10 mm, z 5–15.
- I cut the Base with a 10.4 × 10.4 × 20.4 mm cutter (the Pin grown by 0.4 mm on each axis), so the pocket is 0.2 mm larger on every face the Pin meets.
- The Pin was rebuilt at the same size and position, then the two parts were regrouped.
- The new group is "Group 1" (id group-kugjbb-10). Rename it to "Housing" in the app.
- The old group's steps stay in the History.

Checks: the Pin still reads 10 × 10 × 20 with min z 10. The Base is still 40 wide and 10 tall. check_printability on the group: watertight, 0 errors, 0 warnings, thinnest wall 4.8 mm, fits the build volume.

Problems met:
- The Base's existing pocket size could not be read, since the cutter that made it was consumed earlier. The new pocket is 10.4 mm square, so the gap is 0.2 mm by construction. If the old pocket was larger than that, it still is. Slice the part, or check the pocket in the app, to confirm the fit.
- check_clearance cannot measure two parts of one group against each other, so the gap was not measured directly.
- The group was rebuilt as "Group 1" because no tool renames a body.
